parameters.query:
SELECT metric, value
FROM (
  SELECT 'users_total'::text AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM users
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'subscriptions_status_' || COALESCE(status, 'null') AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
    FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'messages_from_' || COALESCE("from", 'null') AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
    FROM whatsapp_mensasagens GROUP BY "from"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'messages_origin_' || COALESCE(origem, 'null') AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
    FROM whatsapp_mensasagens GROUP BY origem
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'chat_history_rows' AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM n8n_chat_histories
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'chat_history_sessions' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)::bigint AS value FROM n8n_chat_histories
) metrics
ORDER BY metric;
